sum: Immunovant, Inc., a clinical-stage immunology company, develops targeted therapies to meet the needs of people with autoimmune diseases. It develops IMVT-1402, a human monoclonal antibody that inhibits neonatal fragment crystallizable receptor for graves' disease, rheumatoid arthritis, sjögren's disease, cutaneous lupus erythematosus disease, myasthenia gravis, and chronic inflammatory demyelinating polyneuropathy. The company was founded in 2018 and is based in Durham, North Carolina. Immunovant, Inc. operates as a subsidiary of Roivant Sciences Ltd.
ceo: Dr. Eric  Venker M.D., Pharm.D. (CEO & Director)
